newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Intel Q1, yr ests raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Intel Q1, yr ests raised.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it raised first quarter estimates on Intel Corp to $2.08 a share from $2 a share and full-year 1997 to $8.93 from $8.85.

-- Intel is due to report results after the market close today, with Wall Street traders saying the upper-end "whisper number" for the company's earnings is around $2.15 a share, with some seeing $2.20 a share as possible.
-- Lehman analyst Michael Gumport was not immediately available for comment.
-- Intel shares, which fell roughly 11 percent in the last three trading sessions of last week, rose 2-1/2 to 133.
